description: Fetches university rankings from Shiksha.com ranking pages including QS, THE, US News, and more.

function.description:
要调用的功能名。可用值:
  - get_rankings: 获取指定大学的排名数据表格（QS/THE/US News等）
  - get_university_info: 获取大学基本信息

country.description: 国家代码（小写）。例如: usa, uk, canada, australia, germany

university_slug.description: 大学的URL slug标识符。例如: the-university-of-texas-at-austin, massachusetts-institute-of-technology, university-of-oxford
